name: Huss Rooms | [Locust]
desc:
😱 Can you survive the Backrooms?

Captain Clark, Verity & The Locust are hunting you down! Run, hide, fight back, and survive! 👀

🔥 FEATURES
👹 Clark, Verity & The Locust — Escape before they catch you!
💥 Fight Back — Throw props & use Tools to ragdoll the monsters!
📦 Props — Spawn, grab, throw & rotate!
🎉 Events — New chaos every few minutes!
🎁 Playtime Gifts — Unlock rewards & Tools!
👣 Walk & Earn — Earn HussPoints & buy Tools!
👥 Up to 50 Players!
😈 Morph — Become Clark or Verity!

📜 CREDITS & ATTRIBUTION
Base map by @A_CertifiedDingus (Creator Store), rebuilt & modified by @VexorCreator.
Captain Clark model by FnafStuff (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0).

💡 INSPIRATION
Inspired in part by “[BIG UPDATE] Clark (EARLY ACCESS) - Huss rooms” by Moist Carpet.
Our game is independently developed and includes its own gameplay, systems, features, and modifications.

🏷️ Captain Clark, Verity, Locust, Bolied One, Huss Rooms, Backrooms, Horror, Survival, Nextbot, Evade

scripts.title: Inf stamina
scripts.features: This script is only a simple inf stamina which means u can sprint forever
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local cfg = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.SprintConfig)
cfg.DrainRate = 0
cfg.RegenRate = 9999
cfg.MaxStamina = 100
cfg.MinStaminaToSprint = 0

if _G.__InfStamConn then pcall(function() _G.__InfStamConn:Disconnect() end) end
_G.__InfStamConn = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if cfg.DrainRate ~= 0 then cfg.DrainRate = 0 end
    if cfg.RegenRate ~= 9999 then cfg.RegenRate = 9999 end
    if cfg.MinStaminaToSprint ~= 0 then cfg.MinStaminaToSprint = 0 end
end)

print("[inf-stamina] enabled")
